Higher = more conservative#(lf)yoy_cap_first   <- 0.70  # cap FIRST forecast <= this * last year's same month#(lf)# -------------------------------#(lf)#(lf)# ---- helpers: integer months are bulletproof ----#(lf)to_ym <- function(d){                  # map Date -> integer month index (1-based)#(lf)  d0 <- as.Date(d); ok <- !is.na(d0)#(lf)  ym <- rep(NA_integer_, length(d0))#(lf)  if(any(ok)){#(lf)    y <- as.integer(format(d0[ok], ""%Y""))#(lf)    m <- as.integer(format(d0[ok], ""%m""))#(lf)    ym[ok] <- (y * 12L) + m            # e.g., 2025-01 -> 24301#(lf)  }#(lf)  ym#(lf)}#(lf)ym_to_eom <- function(ym){             # map integer month -> true month-end Date#(lf)  res <- as.Date(rep(NA, length(ym)))#(lf)  ok  <- !is.na(ym)#(lf)  if(any(ok)){#(lf)    y  <- (ym[ok] - 1L) %/% 12L#(lf)    m  <- (ym[ok] - 1L) %% 12L + 1L#(lf)    y2 <- y + (m == 12L)#(lf)    m2 <- (m %% 12L) + 1L              # first day of NEXT month#(lf)    first_next <- as.Date(sprintf(""%04d-%02d-01"", y2, m2))#(lf)    res[ok] <- first_next - 1#(lf)  }#(lf)  res#(lf)}#(lf)#(lf)df <- dataset#(lf)#(lf)# 1) make sure core columns exist and numeric#(lf)df$Actuals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df$Actuals))#(lf)for(nm in c(""Volume"",""Lower"",""Upper"")) if(!nm %in% names(df)) df[[nm]] <- NA_real_#(lf)df$Volume <- as.numeric(df$Volume); df$Lower <- as.numeric(df$Lower); df$Upper <- as.numeric(df$Upper)#(lf)#(lf)# 2) compute year-month key, de-dupe by month (keep the row with an Actual if present)#(lf)df$ym <- to_ym(df$Date)#(lf)df     <- df[order(df$ym, is.na(df$Actuals)), ]#(lf)df     <- df[!duplicated(df$ym), ]#(lf)row.names(df) <- NULL#(lf)#(lf)# 3) last index where BOTH month and actual exist#(lf)hist_idx <- which(!is.na(df$ym) & !is.na(df$Actuals))#(lf)if(length(hist_idx) < 6){ result <- df[, setdiff(names(df), ""ym"")] } else {#(lf)  last_idx <- max(hist_idx)#(lf)  last_ym  <- df$ym[last_idx]#(lf)#(lf)  # 4) build exact future months and append ONLY the missing ones#(lf)  targets  <- (last_ym + 1L):(last_ym + forecast_months)     # exact year-months to have#(lf)  new_ym   <- setdiff(targets, df$ym)#(lf)  if(length(new_ym) > 0){#(lf)    fut <- data.frame(#(lf)      ym      = new_ym,#(lf)      Date    = ym_to_eom(new_ym),      # filled later again, but handy#(lf)      Actuals = NA_real_,#(lf)      Volume  = NA_real_,#(lf)      Lower   = NA_real_,#(lf)      Upper   = NA_real_#(lf)    )#(lf)    # carry single-valued dims (e.g., Regime/Category=""All"")#(lf)    for(nm in setdiff(names(df), names(fut))){#(lf)      if(nm %in% c(""ym"",""Date"",""Actuals"",""Volume"",""Lower"",""Upper"")) next#(lf)      val <- na.omit(unique(df[[nm]]))#(lf)      fut[[nm]] <- if(length(val)==1) val[1] else NA#(lf)    }#(lf)    # column order to match df#(lf)    fut <- fut[, names(df)]#(lf)    df  <- rbind(df, fut)#(lf)  }#(lf)#(lf)  # 5) re-order by month and set Date = month-end deterministically#(lf)  df <- df[order(df$ym), ]#(lf)  df$Date <- ym_to_eom(df$ym)#(lf)#(lf)  # 6) stitch history into Volume#(lf)  df$Volume[1:last_idx] <- df$Actuals[1:last_idx]#(lf)#(lf)  # 7) training window (recent 24–30 months)#(lf)  y_hist <- df$Actuals[1:last_idx]#(lf)  if(length(y_hist) > lookback_months){#(lf)    keep <- (last_idx - lookback_months + 1):last_idx#(lf)    y_hist <- df$Actuals[keep]#(lf)    d_hist <- df$Date[keep]#(lf)    ym_hist<- df$ym[keep]#(lf)  } else {#(lf)    d_hist <- df$Date[1:last_idx]#(lf)    ym_hist<- df$ym[1:last_idx]#(lf)  }#(lf)#(lf)  # 8) optional regressors (Sep-25 break)#(lf)  mk_regs <- function(dvec){#(lf)    if(!use_break) return(NULL)#(lf)    step <- as.integer(dvec >= break_date)#(lf)    # ramp: months since break (0 before)#(lf)    ymf  <- to_ym(dvec)#(lf)    ramp <- pmax(0L, ymf - to_ym(break_date) + 1L)#(lf)    cbind(step=step, ramp=ramp)#(lf)  }#(lf)  x_tr <- mk_regs(d_hist)#(lf)#(lf)  # 9) forecast for all rows after the last actual#(lf)  h   <- nrow(df) - last_idx#(lf)  if(h > 0){#(lf)    d_fut <- df$Date[(last_idx+1):nrow(df)]#(lf)    x_f   <- mk_regs(d_fut)#(lf)#(lf)    if(requireNamespace(""forecast"", quietly=TRUE)){#(lf)      library(forecast)#(lf)      y_ts <- ts(y_hist, frequency = 12)#(lf)#(lf)      fit <- if(is.null(x_tr)) auto.arima(y_ts, stepwise=FALSE, approximation=FALSE)#(lf)             else               auto.arima(y_ts, xreg=x_tr, stepwise=FALSE, approximation=FALSE)#(lf)#(lf)      fc  <- if(is.null(x_f))  forecast(fit, h=h, level=95)#(lf)             else               forecast(fit, xreg=x_f, h=h, level=95)#(lf)#(lf)      # conservative blend with seasonal naive#(lf)      sna <- snaive(y_ts, h=h, level=95)#(lf)      meanF <- (1-w_blend)*fc$mean          + w_blend*sna$mean#(lf)      lowF  <- (1-w_blend)*fc$lower[,""95%""] + w_blend*sna$lower[,""95%""]#(lf)      upF   <- (1-w_blend)*fc$upper[,""95%""] + w_blend*sna$upper[,""95%""]#(lf)#(lf)      # first-month YoY cap#(lf)      if(is.finite(yoy_cap_first)){#(lf)        ly <- as.Date(sprintf(""%d-%02d-01"",#(lf)                 as.integer(format(d_fut[1],""%Y""))-1,#(lf)                 as.integer(format(d_fut[1],""%m""))))#(lf)        mon_hist <- format(df$Date[1:last_idx], ""%Y-%m"")#(lf)        ii <- which(mon_hist == format(ly, ""%Y-%m""))#(lf)        if(length(ii)==1 && is.finite(df$Actuals[ii])){#(lf)          cap1 <- yoy_cap_first * df$Actuals[ii]#(lf)          if(is.finite(cap1) && as.numeric(meanF[1]) > cap1) meanF[1] <- cap1#(lf)        }#(lf)      }#(lf)#(lf)      idx <- (last_idx+1):nrow(df)            # overwrite any existing forecasts#(lf)      df$Volume[idx] <- as.numeric(meanF)#(lf)      df$Lower [idx] <- as.numeric(lowF)#(lf)      df$Upper [idx] <- as.numeric(upF)#(lf)#(lf)    } else {#(lf)      # fallback: base Holt-Winters#(lf)      y_ts <- ts(y_hist, frequency=12)#(lf)      pr   <- stats::predict(stats::HoltWinters(y_ts), n.ahead=h, prediction.interval=TRUE, level=0.95)#(lf)      idx  <- (last_idx+1):nrow(df)#(lf)      df$Volume[idx] <- as.numeric(pr[,""fit""])#(lf)      df$Lower [idx] <- as.numeric(pr[,""lwr""])#(lf)      df$Upper [idx] <- as.numeric(pr[,""upr""])#(lf)    }#(lf)  }#(lf)#(lf)  result <- df[, setdiff(names(df), ""ym"")]     # drop helper column#(lf)}",[dataset=#"Sorted Rows"]),
    result = #"Run R script"{[Name="result"]}[Value],

in
